newsitem.title: EGYPT: EGYPT BANK TO INCREASE AUTHORISED CAPITAL.
newsitem.headline: EGYPT BANK TO INCREASE AUTHORISED CAPITAL.

text.p: Egypt's Alexandria Commercial and Maritime Bank said on Sunday it wanted to increased its authorised capital to 300 million pounds ($88.36 million) from 100 million pounds.
The bank said it would hold an extraordinary shareholders meeting on 28 June to approve the capital increase.

In April, the state sold 26.47 percent of its stake in the joint-venture bank as part of its privatisation programme. The bank has shares listed on the Egyptian stock exchange and denominated in Egyptian pounds and U.S. dollars.
